entities.name: Johrum
entities.description: Izzet weird and former attendant to the chemister Erno Zslod, who shifts between fire and a humanoid form.

entities.name: Erno Zslod
entities.description: Great Izzet chemister trapped in his mizzium suit in the Undercity; killed by a mutant.

entities.name: Undercity of Ravnica
entities.description: Where Erno and Johrum were trapped for over thirty years.

entities.name: Madarrak
entities.description: Guildmage who sought out Erno and teleported away with the focusing lens.

entities.name: Castan
entities.description: Companion of Madarrak who sought Erno.

events.summary: Erno and Johrum were exposed to a Simic biomancer's contagion and teleported to the Undercity.
events.quote: it brought him and Johrum directly to the Undercity of Ravnica

events.summary: Madarrak and Castan found Erno and were attacked by Kraul and a mutant.
events.quote: they were attacked by swarms of Kraul

events.summary: Johrum knocked the mutant off Madarrak; the mutant killed Erno, leaving Johrum masterless.
Madarrak teleported away with the focusing lens.
events.quote: Madarrak ended up teleporting away with the focusing lens

relations.quote: former attendant to the chemister Erno Zslod
